target: UTM-bundled QEMU, AArch64 PCI, one vCPU, disposable ISO source volume
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device -netdev user,id=net0 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=net0,disable-legacy=on' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-tosmisc-diskcheckall-current-latest.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-system-context --demo-system-path /Demo/AcctExample/TOS/TOSMisc.ZC --demo-system-module /Demo/AcctExample/TOS/TOSConfig.ZC --demo-system-module /System/Gr/ScreenCast.ZC --demo-system-module /System/BlkDev/DiskCheck.ZC --demo-system-module /Apps/Psalmody/Load.ZC --demo-system-module /Demo/AcctExample/TOS/TOSMisc.ZC
result: pass: DiskCheckAll safely skips non-block source volume C and absent optional D; other TOSMisc/JukePuppet runtime checks passed
verified: TOSInit reports the default TOS drive configuration.
DiskCheckAll returns without a Drive exception when the configured C volume is source-backed and no D block drive is mounted.
TOSMisc exact-font OCR and MemTest pass.
JukePuppet stock-song and Beep-fixture execution/cleanup pass.
The graphical terminal recovers and final zstatus reports failed=0.
limits: The ARM64 adaptation only invokes the stock checker for present RedSea/FAT32 drives; this run had no physical RedSea/FAT32 drive mounted.
Repair behavior and DiskCheckAll with an attached writable drive remain unverified.
Live UTM UI and physical Pi behavior are not established by this headless QEMU run.
